title: Grateful Dead Live at Bayfront Center on 1988-10-16
lineage: Sony D5 > Tascam CDR4U stand alone burner > CDR > EAC (no errors) > Win XP Pro > FLAC Frontend > FLAC 16.
source: 2 Sennheiser ME80 shotguns > Sony D-5 > Maxell MX 90 (first set), TDK MA-XG90 (2nd set). Mic Config: mics in a Y Location: right side of soundboard

ai_review.summary: Warm, clear recording of a masterpiece show with a brilliant ending suite despite slight level distortion.
ai_review.review: The concert is hailed as a masterpiece after a stretch of unremarkable shows, highlighted by an especially brilliant ending suite. The FLAC recording sounds warm and generally clear, though the reviewer notes some level‑related distortion that doesn’t detract from overall enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: A single highly positive review (5★) praises both performance and sound, giving the show a top‑tier rating while noting minor recording issues; limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Slight distortion from level mismatches, but overall warm and clear sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong performance building to a brilliant ending suite; considered a standout show after a period of less special concerts.
